name: Compare working and broken counter pages

planSteps.description: Take the address of the page already open, keep everything before '#' exactly as it is, and open it with '#/l/counter/works' after it (for example .../#/l/counter/works). Do not go to any other site address. Wait 3 seconds
Click the increment button three times

Take the address of the page already open, keep everything before '#' exactly as it is, and open it with '#/l/counter/broken' after it (for example .../#/l/counter/broken). Do not go to any other site address. Wait 3 seconds
Click the increment button three times
Verify the broken page shows a count other than 3
